API-KEY:{KEY NO BRACKETS}.description:
To interact with the MeshAPI, send requests with the API key that you generated on the API Keys settings page.

Example:

curl -X 'GET' \ 'https://hub-us.emailsecurity.app/api/customers/' -H 'API-KEY:{KEY_NO_BRACKETS}'
